description: Download and store one record — a paper (pmid:, doi:), a drug label (dailymed:<set ID>) or a trial record (nct:<8 digits>) — and return its status JSON. A paper gets its record, abstract and correction notices from PubMed (Crossref for a DOI PubMed does not index), then the full text from the configured sources; a label or trial record is stored as a full text. A stored full text is returned without any download; an abstract-level record retries only sources that failed transiently; a record older than 30 days gets its notices re-read.

id.description: ID as "type:value": a paper "pmid:30955454" (bare digits count as pmid) or "doi:10.5812/asjsm.110753" (a paper PubMed does not index; a DOI PubMed indexes is taken as its PMID), a drug label "dailymed:<set ID>" (the set ID from its DailyMed page URL), or a trial record "nct:05173896" (the eight digits; nct:NCT05173896 and a bare NCT05173896 are accepted).

name: library_add
